full_clause_decisions.clause: Attained minimum query regret is bounded by the cumulative average
full_clause_decisions.explanation: For every positive integer T, actual finite regret values form a nonempty finset, whose genuine minimum is attained at an index in1..T and is below every query regret. The exact full selected finite-average proof supplies one query below the average. The result does not assume no regret or nonnegative regret.
